lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh a(n)dh na chetanee janam mar hohi binaas ||
lines.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not think of the Lord; they are ruined through birth and death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh tinee naam dhiaaiaa jin ka(n)u dhur poorab likhiaas ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is their destiny, pre-ordained by the Primal Lord God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਛਤੀਹ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਇਐ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam hamaaraa bhojan chhateeh parakaar jit khaaiai ham kau tripat bhaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is my food; eating the thirty-six varieties of it, I am satisfied and satiated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਨੰਗੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਹ ਹੋਰ ਪੈਨਣ ਕੀ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸਰਧ ਗਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam hamaaraa painan jit phir na(n)ge na hovah hor painan kee hamaaree saradh gaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is my clothing; wearing it, I shall never be naked again, and my desire to wear other clothing is gone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਵਣਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਹਮ ਕੰਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਰਕੁਨੀ ਦੀਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam hamaaraa vanaj har naam vaapaar har naamai kee ham ka(n)u satigur kaarakunee deeee ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is my business, the Lord's Name is my commerce; the True Guru has blessed me with its use.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਕਾ ਹਮ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਭ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਅਗਲੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਗਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naamai kaa ham lekhaa likhiaa sabh jam kee agalee kaan gaee ||
lines.translation: I record the account of the Lord's Name, and I shall not be subject to death again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਪਈ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam guramukh kinai viralai dhiaaiaa jin ka(n)u dhur karam paraapat likhat paee ||17||
lines.translation: Only a few, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Lord's Name; they are blessed by the Lord, and receive their pre-ordained destiny. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਤੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jagat agiaanee a(n)dh hai doojai bhaai karam kamaai ||
lines.translation: The world is blind and ignorant; in the love of duality, it engages in actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਨਿ ਧਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai jete karam kare dukh lagai tan dhaai ||
lines.translation: But those actions which are performed in the love of duality, cause only pain to the body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee sukh oopajai jaa gur kaa sabad kamaai ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, peace wells up, when one acts according to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee baanee karam kare anadin naam dhiaai ||
lines.translation: He acts according to the True Word of the Guru's Bani; night and day, he meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੇ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jit aape laae tit lage kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, as the Lord Himself engages him, so is he engaged; no one has any say in this matter. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham ghar naam khajaanaa sadaa hai bhagat bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
lines.translation: Within the home of my own being, is the everlasting treasure of the Naam; it is a treasure house, overflowing with devotion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਸਦ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur daataa jee kaa sad jeevai devanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the Giver of the life of the soul; the Great Giver lives forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin keeratan sadaa karahi gur kai sabad apaaraa ||
lines.translation: Night and day, I continually sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise, through the Infinite Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਸਦ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵਰਤਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad guroo kaa sad ucharahi jug jug varataavanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: I recite continually the Guru's Shabads, which have been effective throughout the ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu manooaa sadaa sukh vasai sahaje kare vaapaaraa ||
lines.translation: This mind ever abides in peace, dealing in peace and poise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar gur giaan har ratan hai mukat karaavanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: Deep within me is the Guru's Wisdom, the Lord's jewel, the Bringer of liberation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jis no nadar kare so paae so hovai dar sachiaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace obtains this, and is judged to be True in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਾਇ ਪਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n so gurasikh kaheeai jo satigur charanee jaai paiaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who goes and falls at the Feet of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n so gurasikh kaheeai jin har naamaa mukh raam kahiaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who with his mouth, utters the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n so gurasikh kaheeai jis har naam suniai man anad bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, whose mind, upon hearing the Lord's Name, becomes blissful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n so gurasikh kaheeai jin satigur sevaa kar har naam laiaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who serves the True Guru, and so obtains the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਕੰਉ ਹੰਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਚਲਿਆ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: tis gurasikh ka(n)u ha(n)u sadaa namasakaaree jo gur kai bhaanai gurasikh chaliaa ||18||
lines.translation: I bow forever in deepest respect to that Sikh of the Guru, who walks in the Way of the Guru. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਭ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manahath kinai na paaio sabh thake karam kamaai ||
lines.translation: No one has ever found the Lord through stubborn-mindedness. All have grown weary of performing such actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manahath bhekh kar bharamade dukh paaiaa doojai bhaai ||
lines.translation: Through their stubborn-mindedness, and by wearing their disguises, they are deluded; they suffer in pain from the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ridh sidh sabh mohu hai naam na vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: Riches and the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas are all emotional attachments; through them, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does not come to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa te man niramal hovai agiaan a(n)dheraa jaai ||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, the mind becomes immaculately pure, and the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਘਰਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam ratan ghar paragat hoaa naanak sahaj samaai ||1||
lines.translation: The jewel of the Naam is revealed in the home of one's own being; O Nanak, one merges in celestial bliss. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:
